## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Evidence

Explain what was observed, what control was checked, and what remains uncertain.

## Validation

List the commands or evaluation cases you actually ran. Do not paste credentials, client source, production data, or private vulnerability details.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept test data synthetic or safely public.
- [ ] I did not turn a scanner match into an automatic vulnerability claim.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests or clearly documented why they were not run.
- [ ] Scanner-rule changes include positive and negative coverage.
- [ ] Skill-behavior changes include or update an evaluation case.
- [ ] Documentation describes limitations without overstating guarantees.
- [ ] Security issues in KodeWaspada itself are reported through the process in SECURITY.md, not disclosed here.
